request.initial_prompt: In one respect, however, the majority of both sexes resemble, and equally show a want of taste and modesty. Ignorant women, forced to be chaste to preserve their reputation, allow their imagination to revel in the unnatural and meretricious scenes sketched by the novel writers of the day, slighting as insipid the sober dignity and matronly grace of history,* whilst men carry the same vitiated taste into life, and fly for amusement to the wanton, from the unsophisticated charms of virtue, and the grave respectability of sense.

raw_segments.text: In one respect, however, the majority of both sexes resemble, and equally show a want of taste and modesty.
Ignorant women, forced to be chaste to preserve their reputation, allow their imagination to revel in the unnatural and meretricious scenes sketched by the novel writers of the day,
slighting as insipid the sober dignity and matronly grace of history, whilst men carry the same vitiated taste into life,
and fly for amusement to the wanton, from the unsophisticated charms of virtue, and the grave respectability of sense.
